summary: Iteration 81 - Simple/Advanced Mode Toggle Testing. ALL 20 TESTS PASSED (100%). The scanner correctly implements simple mode (default) with only capture and validate buttons, and advanced mode with filters (N&B, Contraste+, Original), rotation (left/right), and multi-page support. Mode switching works correctly from both guide page toggle and preview 'Mode avance' button.

TEST_1_SCANNER_OPENS.details: Scanner modal opens from DocumentUploader scanner-open-btn (visible on mobile). Shows document-scanner test-id.

TEST_2_HEADER_SIMPLE_INDICATOR.details: Header shows '(Simple)' text when in simple mode - 'CamScanner(Simple)'

TEST_3_GUIDE_BADGE_SIMPLE.details: Guide page badge shows 'Mode simple — capture photo directe'

TEST_4_TOGGLE_BTN_TEXT.details: Toggle button on guide page shows 'Activer le mode avance (filtres, rotation...)'

TEST_5_TOGGLE_CHANGES_BADGE.details: Clicking toggle changes badge to 'Mode avance — filtres, rotation, multi-pages'

TEST_6_FILE_UPLOAD_WORKS.details: File upload triggers Web Worker processing and shows preview

TEST_7_NO_TOOLBAR_IN_SIMPLE.details: advanced-toolbar (data-testid) does NOT exist in DOM when in simple mode

TEST_8_NO_FILTERS_IN_SIMPLE.details: Filter buttons (filter-bw, filter-enhanced, filter-original) not visible in simple mode

TEST_9_NO_ROTATION_IN_SIMPLE.details: Rotation buttons (rotate-left-btn, rotate-right-btn) not visible in simple mode

TEST_10_SIMPLE_BUTTONS_EXIST.details: Simple mode preview shows: preview-confirm-btn ('Valider / Sauvegarder'), preview-retake-btn ('Reprendre'), switch-advanced-btn ('Mode avance')

TEST_11_NO_ADD_PAGE_IN_SIMPLE.details: preview-add-page-btn ('Page suivante') NOT visible in simple mode

TEST_12_TOOLBAR_IN_ADVANCED.details: advanced-toolbar appears after clicking 'Mode avance' button

TEST_13_FILTERS_IN_ADVANCED.details: All 3 filter buttons visible in advanced mode: filter-bw, filter-enhanced, filter-original

TEST_14_ROTATION_IN_ADVANCED.details: Both rotation buttons visible in advanced mode: rotate-left-btn, rotate-right-btn

TEST_15_ADD_PAGE_IN_ADVANCED.details: preview-add-page-btn ('Page suivante') appears in advanced mode

TEST_16_SWITCH_BTN_REPLACED.details: switch-advanced-btn is removed after switching to advanced mode, replaced by 'Page suivante'

TEST_17_BW_FILTER_SELECTABLE.details: Clicking filter-bw highlights it with bg-emerald-500 class

TEST_18_ENHANCED_FILTER_SELECTABLE.details: Clicking filter-enhanced highlights it with bg-emerald-500 class

TEST_19_ROTATION_CLICKABLE.details: rotate-right-btn is clickable and triggers rotation (Worker processes image)

TEST_20_SAVE_WORKS_IN_SIMPLE.details: Clicking 'Valider / Sauvegarder' in simple mode saves file and closes scanner

features_validated.simple_mode_default: Scanner opens in simple mode by default (isSimpleMode=true in useScannerWorker.js)
features_validated.simple_mode_ui: Only shows: capture button, Valider/Sauvegarder, Reprendre, Mode avance
features_validated.advanced_mode_ui: Shows: filter toolbar (N&B, Contraste+, Original), rotation buttons, Page suivante, Valider
features_validated.mode_toggle_guide: Toggle button on guide page switches mode and updates badge text
features_validated.mode_toggle_preview: 'Mode avance' button in preview switches to advanced mode
features_validated.filter_functionality: All 3 filters (bw, enhanced, original) work correctly via Web Worker
features_validated.rotation_functionality: Left/right rotation work correctly via Web Worker
features_validated.file_upload: File upload works in both simple and advanced modes
features_validated.save_functionality: Save/Valider works correctly, closes scanner and passes file to parent

key_test_ids.toggle-mode-btn: Guide page toggle button to switch simple/advanced
key_test_ids.switch-advanced-btn: Preview button to switch to advanced mode (only in simple mode)
key_test_ids.advanced-toolbar: Filter+rotate toolbar container (only in advanced mode)
key_test_ids.preview-add-page-btn: Page suivante button (only in advanced mode)

notes: Emergent badge at bottom can intercept clicks on buttons near bottom of screen - use force=True or JS click
Mode state resets when scanner is closed and reopened (expected behavior as isSimpleMode is hook state)
Scanner button (scanner-open-btn) only visible on mobile viewport due to 'flex sm:hidden' class

critical_code_review_comments: Simple/advanced mode implementation is clean and follows React best practices
Conditional rendering of advanced-toolbar uses isSimpleMode state correctly
Mode toggle properly updates both UI state and badge text
Web Worker architecture handles filter/rotation in both modes
Test IDs are well-named and consistent (toggle-mode-btn, switch-advanced-btn, advanced-toolbar)

test_credentials.access_path: /dossier-express -> click CTA button -> scroll to find scanner-open-btn (mobile only)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 81 validates simple/advanced mode toggle feature. Key testing notes: 1) Scanner opens in simple mode by default, 2) Use JavaScript click (page.evaluate) to avoid Emergent badge overlay interception, 3) advanced-toolbar test-id only exists in advanced mode - use count() to verify absence, 4) Mode resets on scanner close/reopen, 5) File upload path works well for headless testing
